availability_audit: Chronology: Beau stands on Route 111 immediately after the Heat Badge, at the start of the cap-42 window. Every member's source gate is 36 or lower and every source map precedes Lavaridge in book play order: Petalburg Woods (C05), Seaspray Cave B1F (early, gate 14), Granite Cave (C12), Mauville Game Corner and the C18 Rock Smash license (C18), Altering Cave rock-smash. Nothing from later in the cap-42 window - no Mirage Tower or desert (C26), no Meteor Falls fishing, no Surf (C27), no Strength area, no legendary.
plan: Rebuilt after attempt 1 lost 2-6. The loss was a type-matchup error on my side, not a difficulty problem: I brought five Pokemon that take Rock at 2x or 4x into a team whose two fastest members both click Rock Slide, and Lycanroc-Dusk plus Archeops swept three of them in two turns. v2 is built to ignore Rock Slide - Steelix takes it at 0.25x, Swampert, Torterra and Garganacl at 0.5x, Mamoswine and Heracross at 1x. It also keeps no Water attack at all, so Storm Drain Gastrodon still has nothing to redirect, and covers Kartana with Fighting rather than Fire.

party.role: Rock-resistant body with single-target Ground (2x on Lycanroc) and Ice (2x on Archeops); deliberately carries no Water move so Storm Drain is dead weight
party.availability: Mudkip from the Mauville Game Corner (500 coins, C18), Marshtomp at 16, Swampert at 36.

party.availability: Onix on the GraniteCave_B1F land table (gate 20), Steelix by Metal Coat trade evolution; the Rustboro Mart stocks the trade items from C06.

party.availability: Turtwig from the Mauville Game Corner (500 coins, C18), Grotle at 18, Torterra at 32.

party.role: Ice is 2x on Archeops and Gastrodon; Ice Shard is the priority answer to a Defeatist Archeops or a weakened Lycanroc
party.availability: Swinub in Seaspray Cave B1F (gate 14), Piloswine at 33, Mamoswine by known-move evolution.

party.role: the Kartana answer without bringing a Rock-weak Fire type; Close Combat is 2x on Kartana and 2x on Lycanroc
party.availability: Heracross on the PetalburgWoods land table (gate 14).

party.availability: Altering Cave 1F rock-smash table (gate 30); Rock Smash license from Mauville (C18).
